hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Armenia 2026–2027. European standard medical curriculum in peaceful Yerevan at highly budget-friendly fees.

overview: Armenia offers Indian medical aspirants European curriculum standards, safe living conditions, and affordable tuition fees. Medical universities in Yerevan feature modern clinical laboratories, well-stocked medical libraries, and extensive clinical rotations in affiliated municipal hospitals.

faq.question: Is MBBS in Armenia valid in India?
faq.answer: Yes, MBBS from NMC & WHO recognized universities in Armenia is valid in India upon passing the NExT/FMGE licensing exam.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying MBBS in Armenia?
faq.answer: The annual tuition fee ranges from ₹2.8 to ₹3.5 Lakhs, with the total 6-year package around ₹18 to ₹25 Lakhs including hostel accommodation.
